PluginData.Tooltip: Your grid's data in windows on the HUD + inventory logistics: sorting, refineries, autocrafting.
PluginData.Description:
Windows with live data of the grid you sit in, drawn on the HUD: power, cargo, ores, ingots, refineries, autocrafting, block details (Automatic LCDs 2 style elements, no LCDs needed). Per-grid profiles and named window templates.
Logistics: sorting into Ores/Ingots/Components/Tools/Ammo/Bottles containers, special containers, equal ore split across refineries with your ore order, ice and uranium balancing, autocrafting by limits split across all assemblers. Works while you sit in the grid; an optional small PB script keeps refineries balanced 24/7.
HUD windows need no LCDs or scripts.
Type /data in chat. Polish and English.
